Chapter 1036: Chapter 3: Global Conflict (Vote for Monthly Pass)_3

So Lin Yuan was quite satisfied with his current situation.

To some extent, Lin Yuan in the Fang Yuan World had a more favorable external environment than in the Chaos Void.

After all, within the Chaos Void, Lin Yuan lacked any solid backing, whereas in the Fang Yuan World, with Lord Qingfen—someone at the peak of the Great Lord level—taking him under his wing, Lin Yuan was completely protected.

Apart from Lord Qingfen, Lin Yuan also belonged to the Fierce Sun Ancient Country camp, which spoke volumes about his background.

“I’ve now restored my strength to the Twelfth Layer Path Splitting Realm.”

Since his last meeting with Lord Qingfen, Lin Yuan’s cultivation resources had flowed continuously and uninterrupted; hence, there were no bottlenecks or setbacks in restoring his strength.

“The Seed of the Fierce Sun is also about to reach thirty thousand units.”

Lin Yuan never gave up on the condensation of the Seed of the Fierce Sun. For him, this wasn’t particularly challenging and didn’t require much effort, so he did it casually in his spare time while cultivating.

“My understanding of the rules has increased to some extent, though it hasn’t been significant,” Lin Yuan thought quietly, not finding it surprising.

In fact, Lord Qingfen’s advice wasn’t wrong. After condensing several thousand or tens of thousands of Seeds of the Fierce Sun, the body undergoes a transformation, making it unnecessary to expend energy to continue condensing more.

Because the effort would outweigh the benefit.

Others weren’t like Lin Yuan—after condensing several thousand or tens of thousands of Seeds of the Fierce Sun, even forming just one more would demand unimaginable effort and mental toil. Why would anyone do that merely to enhance their understanding of the rules by a fraction of a thousandth or ten thousandth?

“I want to see what changes occur after condensing thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun.”

Lin Yuan felt a deep sense of anticipation. Thirty-three hundred and thirty-three Seeds of the Fierce Sun allowed one’s physical body to undergo transformation into the Fierce Sun Divine Body.

But what about thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three Seeds?

In terms of difficulty, the latter far surpassed the former, probably to an extent that only the ancient country royals who could condense Seeds of the Fierce Sun even while sleeping would dare to attempt such a feat.

“Hmm?”

“Did Master send me a message?”

Lin Yuan’s heart stirred as he retrieved a scarlet jade slip, which now had a fresh message on it.

“Do not leave the Sky Burning Court for the time being.”

Lord Qingfen’s message was concise, but for a Great Lord-level figure to personally send such a reminder, it had to be no trivial matter.

Lord Qingfen presided over Qingfen City, overseeing every detail of the settlement beneath his gaze as a pinnacle Great Lord. Logically, even if Lin Yuan left the Sky Burning Court but stayed within Qingfen City, there should be no major concerns.

Lord Qingfen could descend at a moment’s notice.

“Is it because of the threat from the Purple Dream Domain?” Lin Yuan speculated.

Even though he had been mostly immersed in secluded cultivation recently, Lin Yuan occasionally overheard certain news.

Powerful figures from the Purple Dream Domain had frequently been sighted near Qingfen City, seemingly watching for an opportunity.

The Purple Dream Domain was a neighboring domain to Qingfen Domain, originating from an adversarial ancient country.

The Fang Yuan World was vast and boundless, its ancient countries standing like colossal entities. Though the Fierce Sun Ancient Country reigned supreme, it was certainly not alone—there were still opposing ancient countries.

Interactions between ancient countries often involved clashes, especially within the border regions of neighboring domains.

The Purple Dream Great Venerable’s strength was not far beneath that of Lord Qingfen. Lord Qingfen’s advice for Lin Yuan to stay in the Sky Burning Court accounted for the most extreme possibilities.

Should the Purple Dream Great Venerable take direct action, Lord Qingfen would be occupied and unable to guarantee Lin Yuan’s safety.

Having Lin Yuan stay in the Sky Burning Court was due to the fact that it served as the core of Qingfen City’s great formation.

Even for someone as powerful as a pinnacle Great Lord, invading the Sky Burning Court would still require considerable time and effort.

Should such an event truly unfold, it would trigger the Sky Burning Court’s teleportation restriction, instantly sending Lin Yuan to another location—the personal stronghold meticulously prepared by Lord Qingfen, a location of utmost security.

So.

As long as Lin Yuan obediently remained in the Sky Burning Court, even a Heavenly Venerate-level expert would struggle to harm him.

“Well, I’ll just stay here for now then.”

Lin Yuan was rather sensible. Since Lord Qingfen had advised him not to go out, he certainly would not venture out.

Even though this physical body’s demise wouldn’t equate to true death for Lin Yuan, and he could start anew, it would still waste time.

Moreover, if he traveled through dimensions again, whether he would have the same favorable opening conditions was uncertain.

Not every Great Lord-level expert would value their disciple like Lord Qingfen. Many Great Lords were selfish and exploitative, some even grooming disciples explicitly as ‘resources’ for their own cultivation.

…

“The internal universe…”

After re-entering the Twelfth Layer, Lin Yuan’s internal universe began spontaneously evolving, gradually constructing the Thirteenth Layer inheritance “Infinite Void.”

“This Fang Yuan World is fundamentally weak; it lacks the concept of internal universes.” Lin Yuan mused while continuing his cultivation of “Infinite Void.”

“Infinite Void” was not akin to Martial Tao or other evolutionary pathways; instead, it resembled a Secret Technique—a method to transform the internal universe. Thus, it was cultivable even within the Fang Yuan World—a dimension outside the Chaos Void.

“Or is it not that the Fang Yuan World’s experts are inherently weak, but that the Chaos Void’s experts have exceedingly strong foundations?” Lin Yuan wondered to himself.

Within the Chaos Void, ascending to the Twelfth Layer meant receiving Chaos Void Origin Infusion, which accelerated the transformation of the internal universe.

But in this Fang Yuan World, there was no such ‘convenience.’ Were it not for the vast resources supplied by Lord Qingfen, Lin Yuan’s internal world would have taken tremendous time and effort to evolve into an internal universe.

If Lin Yuan struggled this much, other experts would face even greater challenges.

…

Time slid by gradually.

Years passed in the blink of an eye.

On this day, Lin Yuan’s internal universe surged, having fully mastered the First Layer of “Infinite Void,” which rivaled the internal universes of Chaos Venerables.

By now, the strength of Lin Yuan’s foundation absolutely surpassed even that of pinnacle Great Lords like Lord Qingfen.

“Seed of the Fierce Sun…”

Lin Yuan’s expression shifted as he examined himself.

At this moment, countless Seeds of the Fierce Sun permeated his body’s limbs and bones, resembling an endless Sea of Fierce Sun. Meanwhile, new Seeds of the Fierce Sun continued to condense with the passage of time.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan condensed another Seed of the Fierce Sun.

In an instant.

A burgeoning cycle of Seeds of the Fierce Sun formed a preliminary framework, bursting forth with radiant brilliance.

…
